additional_info.subject: RE: ID0409113-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001126] DC_Coils_MG1-MG4_SelfTest CRM:00641001153
additional_info.body:
Dear Yunus,
I hope you are doing well.
We have reviewed the logs, and our initial analysis indicates abnormalities related to the switching matrix, likely due to a contactor issue.
Please check the error flag on SCB first to confirm which component has failed. As of now, the error has been cleared on SCB, so the decision on further action is up to you. However, if the issue reoccurs, please follow below the necessary troubleshooting steps to resolve it.
for IN detail how test is performed please follow the link in wiki:
Matrix Contactors/Coils Self Test - EV Charger Development - Confluence (siemens.cloud)
Contactors in group 0 failed the test & Group 1,2,3 test was skipped.
From <
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/%7b638408754500000190%7d/webresources/msdyn_/RichTextEditorControl/Preview/browserPreviewFrame.html
>
adding to the below information provided earlier
status: failed, reason: smc[0,1,2,3]-[states]-[results]
status: failed, reason: smc[0,1,2,3]-[P,P,P,S]-[0,0,0,0] : in charger
So SMC0 : QA9/QA10
SMC1: QA11/QA12
SMC2: QA17/QA18
SMC3: QA15/QA16
In error code status [F,S,S,S]: denotes SMC0 contactor check  failed & SMC1,2,3 is skipped
[0,0,0,0]: denotes Contactor QA9/QA10 feedback is not received
Steps to Check DC Contactor Operation (24V Supply)
1. Power Supply Verification
🔹 Ensure a stable
24V DC supply
is available and correctly connected to the contactor coil terminals.
🔹 Use a
multimeter
to measure the voltage at the coil terminals before energizing.
2. Contactor Pick-Up Test (Engagement Check)
✅ Apply
24V DC
to the coil and observe if the contactor
pulls in (engages)
properly.
✅ Listen for a
clear clicking sound
, indicating proper engagement.
✅ Measure the
coil current
to ensure it is within the rated specifications.
3. Contactor Drop-Out Test (Release Check)
✅ Remove the
24V supply
and check if the contactor
drops out (de-energizes)
correctly.
✅ Ensure there is no delay or
sticking
in the contacts.
✅ Listen for the
release click
sound when the coil is de-energized.
4. Contact Status Verification
✅ Check
NO (Normally Open)
and
NC (Normally Closed)
contacts using a multimeter in
continuity mode
:
When
energized
, NO contacts should
close
, and NC contacts should
open
.
When
de-energized
, NO contacts should
open
, and NC contacts should
close
.
During the site intervention, please carry a spare contactor in case a replacement is needed.
hope this would clear your query.
Spare part contactor-: 8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav
